newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Cricket-Tasmania sink into deeper trouble v Queensland.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Tasmania sink into deeper trouble v Queensland.

text.p: Tasmania sank into deeper trouble in the Sheffield Shield match against Queensland on Friday and were 80 for seven in their second innings at tea on the third day.
The dismal total by the Tasmanians gave them a lead of just four runs over Queensland's first innings total of 244.

Swing bowler Adam Dale, playing in his maiden first-class match, gave himself the chance of a hat-trick by removing Mark Atkinson for 11 and Daniel Marsh for a duck with his final two deliveries before tea.
Tasmania had been 38 for two at lunch but lost captain David Boon for 17 to off-spinner Paul Jackson.
Fast bowler Scott Muller struck shortly after a rain delay to claim Sean Young for a duck before Dale then removed Dene Hills as Tasmania lost three wickets for seven runs.
